```{r}
library(opensr)
```

## 1. Create a project

```{r}
proj <- sr_project_create(file.path(tempdir(), "review-demo"), name = "demo-review")
proj
```

## 2. Build protocol and search log

```{r}
protocol <- sr_protocol_init("Demo protocol", "Does X improve Y?")
protocol <- sr_protocol_validate(protocol)

search <- sr_search_log_init()
search <- sr_search_add(search, "Scopus", "x AND y", n_results = 42)
search$data
```

## 3. Import records and compute flow

```{r}
csv <- system.file("extdata", "toy_records.csv", package = "opensr")
records <- sr_import_csv(csv)
records <- sr_deduplicate(records)

screen_tbl <- sr_screen_template(records)
screen_tbl$reviewer_1 <- "include"
screen_tbl$reviewer_2 <- c("include", rep("exclude", nrow(screen_tbl) - 1))
screen <- sr_screen_dual(screen_tbl)

fulltext <- sr_fulltext_log(data.frame(record_id = 2, reason = "wrong population"))
sr_prisma_flow(sr_flow_data(records, screen, fulltext))
```

## 4. Archive and reproducibility

```{r}
root <- file.path(tempdir(), "review-demo")
sr_archive_bundle(root)
sr_report_reproducibility(root)
```
